name: @borjie/bias-bench
description: Group-fairness + LLM-bias eval harness for Borjie — drives @borjie/bias-handling's 5 LLM bias suites (BBQ, StereoSet, CrowS-Pairs, HONEST, RealToxicityPrompts) and the AIF360-style group-fairness metrics as an in-tree CI gate. Runner-only; ships deterministic baseline brains so CI runs without a live key, and accepts a real brain via --model.
